subject: Request: Skyward Accelerator cohort stipend escrow & activation plan
messages:
From: Jenna Lee <jenna@skyward.org>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Skyward cohort stipend request (Sept cohort)

Hi Monica —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Skyward is launching a new accelerator cohort starting Sept 7 and we are coordinating cloud credits and promotional stipends for the cohort participants. Can Redwood provide a partner-sourced stipend allocation (marketplace vouchers / trial credits) that we can disburse to 12 teams?

Ask: 50k tokens equivalent (flexible split) + ability to extend trials for teams who hit milestones through Nov 30. We need escrow-style custody so Skyward can ensure credits are applied only to eligible accounts.

Attached is a simple MOA outlining cohort criteria and provisional activation schedule. Can you confirm timelines and who on your side owns the activation flow (DocuSign + voucher issuance)?

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

— Jenna
Jenna Lee
Head of Partnerships, Skyward Accelerator
[Attachment: Skyward_MOA.pdf (PDF)]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodai.com>
To: Jenna Lee <jenna@skyward.org>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Skyward cohort stipend request (Sept cohort)

Hi Jenna —

Thanks for the MOA and context. Looping in Vanessa (Partner Ops) and Ben (Partner Sales) to confirm allocation approach and escrow process. A couple quick clarifying questions so we scope properly:

- Do you want a single voucher pool (50k total) that Skyward distributes, or discrete per-team vouchers we create and route?
- Is it acceptable to release 60% up-front and the remainder on milestones, or do you need full availability on day one?
- Any compliance constraints (IP/airgap) for any cohort participants?

Vanessa/Ben — can you weigh in on feasibility, typical escrow flow, and timing for DocuSign + voucher activation? If we can turn this around within 3 business days we can meet the Sept 7 start.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Sr. Partner Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodai.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Skyward cohort stipend request (Sept cohort)

Monica / Ben —

We can do this. Suggestion: approve a conditional escrow release structure: 30k (60%) released as a single voucher pool assigned to Skyward (they manage distribution per your MOA), 20k (40%) held in escrow and released upon milestone attestation (participant demo + usage threshold). This reduces upfront risk and aligns incentives.

I ran a quick schedule and attached a proposed credit_schedule.csv and an activation_instructions.md that Ops can use for issuing the voucher pool and later the per-team topups. Notes:
- We need a HubSpot deal record (see link) and a signed MOA / DocuSign before issuing the first voucher.
- Finance prefers vouchers tied to a billing owner to simplify reconciliation (recommend Ben as billing contact on the deal).
- Compliance: no special controls noted in the MOA; if any cohort member requires private deployment we need to flag it now.

If you want, I can draft the DocuSign envelope with the MOA and the activation checklist so Skyward can sign today. ETA: voucher creation + activation is ~1 business day after signature.

Attachments: credit_schedule.csv, activation_instructions.md

— Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>
To: Jenna Lee <jenna@skyward.org>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Skyward cohort stipend request (Sept cohort) — APPROVED

Hi Jenna —

Good news: Redwood approves the conditional voucher pool approach. Outline below and next steps:

- Approved allocation: 50,000 token-equivalent credits (60/40 split). 30k pool assigned to Skyward; 20k held in escrow for milestone release.
- Billing/recon: Deal DEAL-76412 owned by Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwoodai.com).
- Sign MOA via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign?token=XXYYZZ-placeholder
- Once signed, Vanessa/Ops will create the voucher pool and provide redemption codes within 1 business day.

Jenna — please confirm the preferred distribution model (single pool vs per-team codes). If single pool works, we will send the voucher codes to the Skyward admin contact after signature and provide an ops checklist for milestone claims.

Thanks — looking forward to supporting the cohort.

Best,
Ben Carter
Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]
